description: This file defines a PHP trait 'ParsesIniTrait' within the AWS SDK for PHP, providing methods to load AWS profile configurations from ini files and retrieve the user's home directory across different operating systems.

classes.name: ParsesIniTrait
classes.description: A PHP trait providing utility methods to parse AWS profile ini files and determine user home directory.

methods.name: loadProfiles
methods.description: Loads AWS profile information from a specified ini file and the default config file, merging profiles and standardizing profile names.

methods.name: getHomeDir
methods.description: Determines the user's home directory using environment variables applicable to Linux/Unix and Windows systems.
